nodes.title: La Maison de la Vanille Absolu de Vanille Eau de Parfum 100ml
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Discover the rich and captivating character of La Maison de la Vanille Absolu de Vanille Eau de Parfum 100ml, an indulgent vanilla fragrance created for those who appreciate warm, sophisticated and sensual scents. Far from a simple sweet vanilla perfume, Absolu de Vanille combines the unmistakable richness of vanilla with woody, spicy and aromatic nuances to create a fragrance with depth, elegance and lasting appeal.

Fragrance Notes: Vanilla Absolute, Patchouli, Cistus
Fragrance Family: Vanilla, Woody, Spicy
Scent Profile: Warm, rich, sensual, woody and aromatic

nodes.title: La Maison de la Vanille Ambre Secret Eau de Parfum 100ml
nodes.descriptionHtml:
La Maison de la Vanille Ambre Secret Eau de Parfum opens with a soft touch of powdered vanilla, creating a warm and inviting introduction. The fragrance develops into a sensual woody heart before revealing the rich, sweet and spicy warmth of amber. The combination creates an exotic, comforting and sophisticated scent inspired by the atmosphere of warm countries and tropical forests.

Key Notes: Powdered Vanilla, Woody Accords, Spicy Amber
Fragrance Family: Amber, Vanilla & Woody
Scent Character: Warm, Sweet, Powdery, Spicy, Woody & Sensual

The collection includes Vanille Givrée des Antilles 30ml, Vanille Sauvage de Madagascar 30ml, Vanille Noire du Mexique 30ml, Vanille Fleurie de Tahiti 30ml and Vanille Divine des Tropiques 30ml. La Maison perfume: La Maison de la Vanille

La Maison perfume at Swansura means the La Maison de la Vanille collection: warm, unisex scents that put vanilla at the centre. Three 100ml eaux de parfum cost £19.99 each, which makes them an easy way to try a new signature. Each one wears well on anyone, so they are simple to share.

Three ways with vanilla

La Maison de la Vanille Absolu de Vanille Eau de Parfum is the richest of the three, a vanilla perfume that goes beyond simple sweetness. La Maison de la Vanille Ambre Secret opens with soft, powdered vanilla, moves into a sensual woody heart and finishes sweet and spicy. Royal Oud pairs precious oud with elegant florals, warm woods and musk for something deeper. It is the one to choose if you want vanilla with a smokier, more evening feel.

A boxed collection

The Vanilles des Origines Wooden Coffret holds five 30ml bottles of Eau de Toilette for £84.99. It is a beautifully presented eau de toilette gift set for anyone who loves vanilla and wants to explore different takes on it. The 30ml bottles also travel well, so you can carry a favourite in your bag.

All four sit comfortably in our amber fragrances, and the coffret also appears in perfume gift sets. Prefer something smokier? Try our oud fragrances. Every La Maison perfume is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, with free UK delivery once your basket passes £40.
